entries.label: Block editing and stable block identity
entries.reason: The pinned runtime is build-materialized and executed, but block editing still awaits scored native UI acceptance.

entries.label: Block focus, zoom, outline, and folding
entries.reason: The restricted official stage UI is integrated, but focus, zoom, outline, and folding await scored native UI acceptance.

entries.label: Tables, code, math, diagrams, and callouts
entries.reason: The rich-rendering closure is build-materialized, but tables, code, math, diagrams, and callouts await scored native UI acceptance.

entries.label: Block references, embeds, and backlinks
entries.reason: The typed broker is registered, but reference and backlink operations are not in its approved API subset.

entries.label: Global and focused relationship graph
entries.reason: No SiYuan graph projection is connected to ContextGalaxy.

entries.label: Full-text and focused search
entries.reason: Pinned native full-text search returned the unique final sentinel from the exact 500,000,000-byte authenticated fixture; production route enablement remains separately blocked.

entries.label: Notebook and document tree
entries.reason: Project-scoped runtime, managed notebook mapping, and the restricted official surface are implemented, but the native tree workflow has not completed scored UI acceptance.

entries.label: Tags and bookmarks
entries.reason: No SiYuan metadata projection exists.

entries.label: Assets and attachments
entries.reason: Asset APIs and path policy are not registered.

entries.label: Daily notes
entries.reason: Typed daily-note and Nightly managed-write routes are enabled, but real-runtime daily-note persistence and rollback scoring remain pending.

entries.label: Templates and snippets
entries.reason: Template runtime assets and bridge operations are absent.

entries.label: Attribute-view databases
entries.reason: No typed attribute-view operations are exposed.

entries.label: Database relations, rollups, filters, sorts, and groups
entries.reason: Database parity has not been exercised against v3.8.1.

entries.label: Flashcards and spaced repetition
entries.reason: Flashcard APIs and UI are not integrated.

entries.label: History, snapshots, and rollback
entries.reason: Snapshot-first managed writes and reversible shadow mappings are implemented, but official history UI and real-runtime rollback acceptance remain pending.

entries.label: Supported import and export workflows
entries.reason: Electron-dependent flows have no Tauri bridge.

entries.label: Themes and icons
entries.reason: Appearance bytes and the restricted official knowledge surface are integrated, but theme and icon behavior is not yet scored.

entries.label: Language switching
entries.reason: Language switching has not yet completed scored native UI acceptance.

entries.label: Plugin-capable local knowledge UI
entries.reason: Plugin UI and explicit-install permission boundary are not integrated.

entries.label: Large-document dynamic loading
entries.reason: No official UI performance run has been completed.

entries.label: Local offline operation
entries.reason: The enabled build-materialized runtime has passed owned offline boots and the final SiYuan-enabled installers pass the exact size gate, but scored native UI behavior under an enforced network-denial boundary remains pending.

entries.label: Full official SiYuan knowledge surface inside VibeSpace
entries.reason: The zero-permission exact-loopback official surface is implemented and enabled, but scored native UI acceptance remains pending.
